editorial.blurb: A cozy neighborhood gem celebrating duck in every form, from wings to whole birds, with a relaxed vintage bar and charming garden patio on Chicago's South Side.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation for the whole rotisserie duck if you're committed to the experience, but don't sleep on the Duck Inn Dog (Chicago-style with duck fat)—it's a crowd-pleaser that consistently impresses.
signatureDishes: Duck Inn Dog (Chicago-style with duck fat)
